question: What are the name of badge that users who have the highest reputation obtained?
evidence: highest reputation refers to Max(Reputation); user refers to UserId
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT T2.name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T1.Reputation DESC) AS __r FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T2.name FROM users AS T1 INNER JOIN badges AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.UserId ORDER BY T1.Reputation DESC LIMIT 1

b.request: What are the names of all badges obtained by every user who is tied for the maximum Reputation (returning all tied users' badges, not just one user's)?
b.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM badges b WHERE b.UserId IN (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users))

c.request:
What are the name of badge that users who have the highest reputation obtained?
Evidence: highest reputation refers to Max(Reputation); user refers to UserId
If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
c.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM badges b JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)

d.request: What are the names of the badges obtained by the user(s) with the highest reputation (Max(Reputation)), and if multiple users tie for the highest reputation, return the badges for all of them?
d.sql: SELECT b.Name FROM badges b JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id WHERE u.Reputation = (SELECT MAX(Reputation) FROM users)
